about: Curated map from genome traits to the registered LI hypotheses that test them on real LLM agents (results/li-verdicts.json is the source of each verdict). List only hypotheses whose preregistered statement is about the trait. scripts/coverage.mjs derives the level from the verdicts, so a verdict change cannot leave this map stale.

FLD-01.note: Waiting for the trace (stigmergy with polarity) against a manager agent: harder tasks, equal act rounds, and a manager at default effort with a large plan budget.

FLD-02.note: Traces that evaporate after one or three waves against persistent traces.

FLD-03.note: GN1 library arm (Haiku 5.5, 80-module rc, 5 related sequences): a shared team library cut first-pass failures in 10 of 10 units (Holm p = 0.004), but only by 5.6%, with +57% output tokens.

FLD-04.note: GN1: a per-member notebook cut first-pass failures in 10 of 10 units (p = 0.001), but only by 3% and not on repeated edges, with more waves and +39% output tokens; holdout at floor. Preregistered card: adopt, test more.

ACT-01.note: Random response thresholds break symmetric conflicts; thresholds against a group chat.

ACT-03.note: Clonal selection on top of agent-written stigmergy and against a manager agent.

SIG-05.note: Lateral inhibition against a leaderless group chat on harder tasks.

DOL-04.note: A manager agent is the leader arm of every LI comparison; this is the registered test of it against leaderless conversation.
